test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, if 'FILM' is written as '9121516' and 'EAST' is written as '842223', how will 'HOME' be written in the same code language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cc527eae5cf4312c72742f2f9207a084cf68a8714b3b2f6a47613860100b0e.png] 

**Logic:** (3) is added to the position value of the alphabet to make the code.

'FILM' is written as '9121516' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8c72bceb3a10417d932ca0f10a2d95bc83440b8f907e5532cb9c2b31051dbb7.png] 

'EAST' is written as '842223' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb6c9675cc81dc79f891cd48e75b961848b4d583731dc1815b626161e17e30bc.png] 

Similarly, 'HOME' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63f695baee4e629d9a90a4d4a7f450233ccc0ba949f0ac91b49af043512178fe.png] 

Here, the code for 'HOME' is **'1118168'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
